name: gpt-session-bridge
description: A local bridge for explicitly selected ChatGPT Web sessions and Codex clients.

scripts.native-host:install: pnpm package:windows && node apps/windows-setup/dist/cli.js install --package artifacts/windows-x64
scripts.package:windows: pnpm build && pnpm package:windows:from-build && pnpm verify:windows-package
scripts.test: pnpm build:workspace-deps && pnpm --recursive --if-present test && pnpm test:windows-ipc
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm build:workspace-deps && pnpm --recursive --if-present test:coverage && pnpm test:windows-ipc
scripts.typecheck: pnpm build:workspace-deps && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && pnpm --recursive --if-present typecheck
scripts.verify: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:coverage && pnpm build && pnpm package:windows:from-build:if-supported && pnpm verify:windows-package:if-supported
